relevanceMeaning: A useful dated report or qualified partial contribution, not fresh factual verification or full coverage.

Which harness-documentation outputs need Graphviz, which survive without it, and why can generated HTML have different licensing concerns?

Why is the earlier component standards matrix unsafe to reuse unqualified, and which reconciled investigation supersedes it?
How can generated schema validators preserve enum and field constraints, and where can contract-generator behavior drift?
Which Python calculation approach produces an auditable HTML report, and does a displayed unit label enforce dimensional correctness?

measurementRule: Record candidate generation separately from actual user-visible final ranking. Preserve fixed queries/relevance on misses; no hidden research or full-archive model input. Bind final accepted report/catalogue revisions before measuring.
priorDraft: Original eleven-report scout draft is preserved separately, not scored or overwritten.
